literal: In the past I did not know that which is called the God of Death; now I have known [it]: with feminine grace, possessing large, battling eyes.
translation: In the past, I did not know what the God of Death was. Now I know: it is a woman of great grace, possessing large, battling eyes.
modern: முன்பெல்லாம் எமன் என்று சொல்லப்படுவதை நான் அறியாமல் இருந்தேன்; பெண் தன்மையோடு, பெரிய போரிடும் கண்களைக் கொண்டவளாக இருக்கும் இவளைக் கண்ட பிறகு இப்போதுதான் அதை அறிந்து கொண்டேன்.
explanation: The hero is completely captivated and overwhelmed by the beauty and the piercing gaze of the heroine. He compares her gaze to the God of Death (கூற்று), who takes away a person's life. In the past, he only knew of Death as an abstract concept, but now he realizes that Death actually takes the form of a woman with feminine grace (பெண்டகை) and large, intense, battling eyes (பேரமர்க் கட்டு) that strike his heart.
